sources.supports: Z.ai's official pricing table lists GLM-5 at $1 input, $0.2 cached input, and $3.2 output per million tokens; cached input storage is free for a limited time.

sources.supports: Z.ai's GLM-5 launch announcement is dated February 12, 2026, after the zero-price entry was recorded.

notes: The provider's launch announcement is dated February 12, while models.dev recorded the zero values on February 11; Z.ai's official pricing table gives the nonzero GLM-5 rates. This supports a models.dev prelaunch placeholder/error rather than an official free-price period. I could not retrieve Internet Archive snapshots (the CDX endpoint returned HTTP 503), so no exact pricing-effective time or archived before/after bracket is available.
